166.news_title: Arcooda Monitors have wide Mounting Options including VESA Mount
166.long_description: Arcooda monitors have the widest mounting options possible and offer VESA mount for desktop stands, wall mounting, and also come with mounting frames so that you can install into arcade machines, industrial equipment or digital display fixtures. Some monitors also come with plug and play mounting frames to install directly into arcade equipment. All current production Arcooda monitors offer VESA mounting options allowing you to use our monitors for desktop, wall mounting, and standalone digital display stands. Our smaller screens off 75x75mm support, whilst larger monitors offer 100x100mm and 200x200mm support enabling you to use either your own VESA stand, or, a VESA monitor stand tested with our monitor range. Further, our monitors come with side mounting brackets with both vertical and horizontal frames. Depending on your video screen opening, you can use vertical or horizontal brackets (or both), and mount the brackets flush with the screen's surface, or, in reverse. We are working on offering product specific mounting frames for various amusement products. Some of our monitors also offer Sega/Namco/UNIS mounting options, with preset mounting points in our monitors. If you are looking for a complete solution, our 16.6inch and 32inch monitors also have options to be shipped to you with the full mounting frame kit - simply remove your old monitor/frame, and reconnect the Arcooda monitor in exactly the same position, its all plug and play. If you are looking for special mounting requests, please reach out to us.
